prefix_referred.en: Keep going to the clinic. Do not stop to reply.
prefix_referred.sw: Endelea kwenda kliniki. Usisimame ili ujibu.
prefix_referred.back: Continue going to the clinic. Do not stop to reply.

ack_referred.en: Thank you, your answer was passed on. Keep going to the clinic.
ack_referred.sw: Asante, jibu lako limefikishwa. Endelea kwenda kliniki.
ack_referred.back: Thank you, your reply has been delivered. Continue going to the clinic.

PA_FITS_COUNT.en: How many fits has the child had in this illness? Reply 1 more than one. 2 one. 3 not sure.
PA_FITS_COUNT.sw: Mtoto amepata degedege mara ngapi kwa ugonjwa huu? Jibu 1 zaidi ya moja. 2 moja. 3 sijui.
PA_FITS_COUNT.back: How many times has the child had convulsions in this illness? Reply 1 more than one. 2 one. 3 I don’t know.

PA_AWAKE.en: Look only, do not shake. Reply 1 not awake or fitting now. 2 awake. 3 not sure.
PA_AWAKE.sw: Angalia tu, usimtikise. Jibu 1 hajaamka au ana degedege sasa. 2 ameamka. 3 huna hakika.
PA_AWAKE.back: Just look, do not shake him/her. Reply 1: he/she has not woken up or is having convulsions now. 2: he/she has woken up. 3: you are not sure.

PA_DRINK_SINCE.en: When did the child stop drinking or sucking? Reply 1 yesterday or earlier. 2 today. 3 not sure.
PA_DRINK_SINCE.sw: Mtoto aliacha kunywa au kunyonya lini? Jibu 1 jana au kabla. 2 leo. 3 huna uhakika.
PA_DRINK_SINCE.back: When did the child stop drinking or breastfeeding? Reply 1 yesterday or before. 2 today. 3 you are not sure.

CK_FITS.en: In this illness, has the child had fits (jerking they could not stop, eyes rolling, body stiff)? Reply 1 yes, fits. 2 no fits. 3 not sure.
CK_FITS.sw: Katika ugonjwa huu, mtoto amepata kifafa (kutetemeka bila kuzuia, macho kuzunguka, mwili kukakamaa)? Jibu 1 ndio, kifafa. 2 hana kifafa. 3 hujui.
CK_FITS.back: In this illness, has the child had convulsions (shaking without control, eyes rolling, body becoming stiff)? Reply 1 yes, convulsions. 2 does not have convulsions. 3 you do not know.

CK_WAKE.en: Call the child's name and touch gently. Do not shake. Reply 1 if they do not wake or fall back asleep at once. 2 if awake and looking at you. 3 not sure.
CK_WAKE.sw: Mwite mtoto kwa jina lake na mguse taratibu. Usimtikise. Jibu 1 kama haamki au analala tena mara moja. 2 yuko macho na anakutazama. 3 huna uhakika.
CK_WAKE.back: Call the child by his/her name and touch him/her gently. Do not shake him/her. Reply 1 if he/she does not wake up or sleeps again immediately. 2 he/she is awake and looking at you. 3 you are not sure.

CK_DRINK.en: Only if the child is awake: offer a drink or the breast, do not force. Reply 1 cannot drink or suck at all, or not awake. 2 drinks or sucks. 3 not sure.
CK_DRINK.sw: Mtoto akiwa macho tu: mpe kinywaji au mnyonyeshe, usilazimishe. Jibu 1 hawezi kunywa/kunyonya kabisa, au hayuko macho. 2 anakunywa/ananyonya. 3 hujui
CK_DRINK.back: Child, only when awake: give a drink or breastfeed, do not force. Reply 1 cannot drink/breastfeed at all, or is not awake. 2 is drinking/breastfeeding. 3 you do not know

CK_VOMIT.en: Since this illness began, does the child vomit up every drink and feed? Reply 1 vomits everything. 2 keeps some down. 3 not sure.
CK_VOMIT.sw: Tangu ugonjwa huu uanze, mtoto hutapika kila anachokunywa au kula? Jibu 1 hutapika kila kitu. 2 hubakisha vingine. 3 sina hakika.
CK_VOMIT.back: Since this illness began, does the child vomit everything they drink or eat? Reply 1 vomits everything. 2 keeps some down. 3 I am not sure.

CK_BLOOD.en: Look at the child's last stool (poo). Reply 1 if you see blood, red or dark. 2 no blood. 3 not sure or no stool.
CK_BLOOD.sw: Angalia kinyesi cha mwisho cha mtoto. Jibu 1 ukiona damu, rangi nyekundu au nyeusi. 2 hakuna damu. 3 huna uhakika au hakuna kinyesi.
CK_BLOOD.back: Look at the child’s last stool. Reply 1 if you see blood, red or black color. 2 no blood. 3 you are not sure or there is no stool.

CK_COUGH_DAYS.en: Has the cough lasted 14 days or more? Reply 1 yes, 14 days or more. 2 less than 14 days. 3 not sure.
CK_COUGH_DAYS.sw: Kikohozi kimekaa siku 14 au zaidi? Jibu 1 ndio, siku 14 au zaidi. 2 chini ya siku 14. 3 sina uhakika.
CK_COUGH_DAYS.back: Has the cough stayed for 14 days or more? Reply 1 yes, 14 days or more. 2 under 14 days. 3 I am not sure.

CK_DIARRHOEA_DAYS.en: Has the diarrhoea lasted 14 days or more? Reply 1 yes, 14 days or more. 2 less than 14 days. 3 not sure.
CK_DIARRHOEA_DAYS.sw: Kuharisha kumedumu siku 14 au zaidi? Jibu 1 ndiyo, siku 14 au zaidi. 2 chini ya siku 14. 3 huna uhakika.
CK_DIARRHOEA_DAYS.back: Has diarrhea lasted 14 days or more? Reply 1 yes, 14 days or more. 2 less than 14 days. 3 you are not sure.

CK_FEVER_DAYS.en: Has the fever lasted 7 days or more, counted from when it started, even on and off? Reply 1 yes. 2 less. 3 not sure.
CK_FEVER_DAYS.sw: Homa imekaa siku 7 au zaidi, ukihesabu tangu ilipoanza, hata kama inakuja na kuisha? Jibu 1 ndio. 2 chini ya 7. 3 sina hakika.
CK_FEVER_DAYS.back: Has the fever lasted 7 days or more, counting from when it started, even if it comes and goes? Reply 1 yes. 2 less than 7. 3 I am not sure.
